GATILHOS.MENSAGEM_FALHOU: When a message to the client fails
GATILHOS.CARD_ENTROU_NA_ETAPA: When the card enters a stage
GATILHOS.CARD_SAIU_DA_ETAPA: When the card leaves a stage
GATILHOS.CARD_PARADO: When the card is stuck in a stage
GATILHOS.CARD_RECORRENTE: On a date or on a schedule, on cards
GATILHOS.CONTATO_RECORRENTE: On a date or on a schedule, on contacts
GATILHOS.CONTA_RECORRENTE: On a date or on a schedule, on the account
GATILHOS.CONVERSA_ETIQUETA_POSTA: When a label is added to the conversation
GATILHOS.CONVERSA_ETIQUETA_TIRADA: When a label is removed from the conversation
GATILHOS.CONTATO_ETIQUETA_POSTA: When a label is added to the contact
GATILHOS.CONTATO_ETIQUETA_TIRADA: When a label is removed from the contact

CONVERSA_NOVA.CAIXA: Inbox to reach someone with no conversation yet
CONVERSA_NOVA.NENHUMA: None (with no conversation, the message is not sent)
CONVERSA_NOVA.AJUDA: If the card or the contact has no conversation yet, the first message opens one in this inbox. On the official WhatsApp, it only goes out with an approved template.

SE_REPETIR.ROTULO: If it happens again while it is still waiting
SE_REPETIR.AJUDA: With "Start again", each new time runs the steps from the beginning, alongside the one that is still waiting.

AGENDA_DE_RESERVA.NENHUMA: None (with nobody attending, the booking link stays empty)
AGENDA_DE_RESERVA.AJUDA: Goes in the booking link when nobody attends the conversation, or the contact has no conversation yet. Whoever attends always sends their own page.

VALOR_DA_MENSAGEM.ENVIADA: from the team to the customer

GATILHO_COM.CARD_CRIADO: When a card is created in {funil}
GATILHO_COM.CARD_GANHO: When a card in {funil} is won
GATILHO_COM.CARD_PERDIDO: When a card in {funil} is lost
GATILHO_COM.CARD_REUNIAO_MARCADA: When a meeting is scheduled on a {funil} card
GATILHO_COM.CARD_REUNIAO_REMARCADA: When a meeting is rescheduled on a {funil} card
GATILHO_COM.CARD_REUNIAO_CANCELADA: When a meeting is canceled on a {funil} card
GATILHO_COM.CARD_RESPONSAVEL_MUDOU: When the owner of a card in {funil} changes
GATILHO_COM.CARD_TIME_MUDOU: When the team of a card in {funil} changes
GATILHO_COM.CARD_REUNIAO_ATENDIDA: When a meeting is held on a {funil} card
GATILHO_COM.CARD_PARADO: When the card is stuck in {etapa} for {dias} days
GATILHO_COM.CONVERSA_ETIQUETA_POSTA: When the label {etiqueta} is added to the conversation
GATILHO_COM.CONVERSA_ETIQUETA_TIRADA: When the label {etiqueta} is removed from the conversation
GATILHO_COM.CONTATO_ETIQUETA_POSTA: When the label {etiqueta} is added to the contact
GATILHO_COM.CONTATO_ETIQUETA_TIRADA: When the label {etiqueta} is removed from the contact

AUTOMACAO_LIVRE.GATILHO_NAO_DISPARA: Does not trigger when many cards are archived at once or when the stage is deleted.

GATILHO_DO_CARD.ERRO_FUNIS: Could not load the pipelines and stages. Close and open it again.

REPETE_DA_DATA.UMA_VEZ: Only on that date, with the year
REPETE_DA_DATA.TODO_ANO: Every year, on the same day and month (birthday)

GATILHO_DE_TEMPO.AVISO_PARADO: Only cards that reach the deadline from now on are included. Cards already more than 1 day past the deadline are left out.
GATILHO_DE_TEMPO.AVISO_DATA: Checked every 15 minutes, in the account time zone. A date written in another format does not count.
GATILHO_DE_TEMPO.SEM_CAMPO: There is no date field here. Create one in Settings › Custom attributes.
GATILHO_DE_TEMPO.ERRO_CAMPOS: Could not load the date fields. Close and open it again.
GATILHO_DE_TEMPO.AVISO_LEMBRETE: If the meeting is rescheduled, it reminds at the new time. If it is canceled, it does not remind. If it is booked with less notice than this, it reminds right away.

GATILHO_DE_REUNIAO.ERRO_PAGINAS: Could not load the booking pages. Close and open again.

GATILHO_RECORRENTE.AVISO: Runs at the chosen time, in the account time zone, once on each card or contact chosen. On day 29, 30 or 31, shorter months use the last day. If it is off at that time, that time does not run later. While the previous time is still running (waiting), the new one does not start.
GATILHO_RECORRENTE.AVISO_CONTA: Runs at the chosen time, in the account time zone, only once (not on each card or contact). Only wait and send campaign fit here. On day 29, 30 or 31, shorter months use the last day. If it is off at that time, that time does not run later. While the previous time is still running (waiting), the new one does not start.
GATILHO_RECORRENTE.AVISO_UMA_VEZ: Runs only once, on the chosen day and time, in the account time zone, on each card or contact chosen. If it is off at that time, it does not run later. Changing only the time after it ran does not send again.
GATILHO_RECORRENTE.AVISO_UMA_VEZ_CONTA: Runs only once, on the chosen day and time, in the account time zone (not on each card or contact). Only wait and send campaign fit here. If it is off at that time, it does not run later. Changing only the time after it ran does not send again.

SELECAO.DICA_CARD: Choose at least one condition. It runs on every card that matches all of them.
SELECAO.DICA_CONTATO: Choose at least one condition. It runs on every contact that matches all of them.

SOLICITANTE.FUNIL: Asked for a card in the pipeline
SOLICITANTE.DICA: Contacts who asked for a card in this pipeline that still has fields to check. One contact per company.
SOLICITANTE.FALTANDO: Still missing when any of these is unchecked

FRASE.MAIOR_QUE: When the card {campo} changes and is above {valor}

MUDANCA.AVISO: A new card counts too: a card created with R$ 80,000 "goes above 50000". A change made by this automation itself does not start it again.
MUDANCA.ERRO_CAMPOS: Could not load the card fields. Open the editor again to retry.
